analysis:
## Technical analysis

### Session overview — stop triggered, new 52-week closing low
SK Hynix (000660.KS) closed at ₩1,842,000 on 2026-07-17, down ₩41,000 (-2.18%) from the prior close of ₩1,883,000. The session high was ₩1,919,000; the intraday low was ₩1,821,000 — a ₩98,000 intraday range. The closing print establishes a new 52-week closing low, breaking below the prior ₩1,850,000 floor and falling ₩25,213 below the framework stop at ₩1,867,213.

### Stop protocol — triggered
The Buy-Side Briefings SK Hynix framework defines a mandatory exit if the KRX daily close falls below ₩1,867,213:

| Stop condition | Threshold | Today's close | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| KRX daily close | ₩1,867,213 | ₩1,842,000 | ✗ TRIGGERED |
| SKHY ADS close | $149.00 | ~$152.31 (low confidence) | ✓ above stop |

The KRX stop is triggered. The ADS stop has not yet been reached. With the primary KRX stop hit, the framework mandates an exit regardless of ADS status.

### The Kimi K3 amplification — KRX vs. SKHY ADS divergence
The Kimi K3 open-weight model announcement (Moonshot AI, 2.8 trillion parameters, 1-million-token context, July 27 release date) dropped during the US session — after the KRX session had already closed. This timing creates a structural divergence:

- **KRX session (02:00–08:00 UTC):** Absorbed the broader macro sell-off (VIX rising, SPX weakening, chip sector pressure) but not the full Kimi K3 shock. KRX fell 2.18%.
- **US session (SKHY ADS):** Absorbed both the KRX decline AND the Kimi K3 shock in a single session. SKHY ADS fell from approximately $176.46 to ~$152.31 — an estimated -13.7% move — compressing the ADS premium vs. KRX parity from 39.6% to approximately 23.2%.

This premium compression is significant: it means US-listed investors are pricing in a more severe structural headwind from AI efficiency improvements than the Korean market has yet digested. When KRX reopens July 18, the Kimi K3 narrative will be a known factor — the remaining ADS-to-KRX premium compression could translate into further KRX downside.

|---|---|---|---|
| KRX close (₩) | 1,883,000 | 1,842,000 | -2.18% |
| KRX USD parity at ₩1,490/$ | $126.38 | $123.62 | -2.18% |
| SKHY ADS | $176.46 | ~$152.31* | ~-13.7%* |
| ADS premium | 39.6% | ~23.2%* | -16.4pp* |

*SKHY ADS data at ~$152.31 is low-confidence (US session post-KRX close; data may be stale or approximate).

### Key levels post-stop
**Mandatory re-entry gate: ₩1,867,213** — This was the stop level; it is now the first resistance above the current close. A position can only be re-entered after KRX reclaims ₩1,867,213 on a daily close, with the Q2 earnings print as the most likely catalyst.

**Intraday low: ₩1,821,000** — The session bottom. The partial recovery to ₩1,842,000 suggests some buyer interest near ₩1,820,000-₩1,825,000, but with the stop already triggered, the session low is primarily a reference for the next KRX session's opening behavior.

**Psychological floor: ₩1,800,000** — The round-number 200만원 threshold below all 2026 closes. Institutional buy programs and long-term value funds may activate near this level.

**52-week range: ₩1,842,000–₩2,987,000** — Today's close IS the new low end. The -38.4% drawdown from the 52-week high represents significant value destruction since the peak of the HBM demand cycle in late 2025.

### Re-entry criteria
A re-entry position in SK Hynix requires ALL of the following:

1. **KRX daily close > ₩1,867,213** — reclaim the stop level; no re-entry below this threshold
2. **Q2 FY2026 earnings beat** — operating profit ≥ ₩6.5T quarterly with strong HBM3e/HBM4 forward demand guidance
3. **VIX < 17** — macro conditions permitting risk-on positioning in Korean memory names
4. **Kimi K3 benchmarks resolved** — if the July 27 open-weight release underperforms on HBM-intensive workloads, the demand thesis partially survives; a strong performance extends the bear case

Q2 earnings on July 29 at 9:00 AM KST (00:00 UTC July 29) is the gating event. The HBM3e shipment volumes and HBM4 qualification timeline with NVDA for GB300 are the two most important disclosures to watch for any re-entry signal.
